meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 把旧的 NanoClaw 和 Claude 原生记忆迁移进共享 memory 目录和中立的常驻指令文件。它会先清点受影响群组、暂存旧文件、隔离符号链接,再由发起迁移的编码工具整理内容、建索引,给出每条文件的去向报告,等你确认后才算完成。
howto.when: 更新提示出现共享记忆破坏性变更后运行;或群组里还留着 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆、未建索引的 imported-agent-memory.md 等遗留文件时。触发词如「migrate memory」「legacy memory」「the agent forgot everything after the switch」。

say.text: 帮我迁移这个群组的旧记忆
say.note: 先展示受影响群组和冲突情况,批准后才移动文件

say.text: 检查一下有没有遗留的 CLAUDE.md 或自动记忆
迁移完给我源到目标的报告
say.note: 列出每个导入文件的最终去向和未处理项

howto.what_en: Migrates legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. It inventories groups, stages files, quarantines symlinks, then the invoking coding harness organizes, indexes and reports each outcome.
howto.when_en: Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md.

say_en.text: Migrate the legacy memory for this group
say_en.note: Shows affected groups, waits for approval before moving files

say_en.text: Check for leftover CLAUDE.md or auto-memory files
say_en.note: Lists .seed.md, CLAUDE.md and other legacy paths and their types

say_en.text: Show me the source-to-destination report after migrating
say_en.note: Lists each imported file's outcome and unresolved items
